detail.longDescription: Gmail and Yahoo Mail (a.k.a. Yahoo! Mail a.k.a. Ymail) are two of the biggest email providers. While the stats are hard to verify and seldom updated, Google's Gmail is reportedly responsible for over a third of opened emails and has 3 billion active users, while the partially Verizon-owned Yahoo Mail—despite launching in 1997—apparently has around 225 million active users per month.
